safetyNotes: Do not mix Clorox Bleach with vinegar, ammonia, toilet cleaners, or other cleaning products.
Do not mix Ajax, bleach, vinegar, Lysol, or shower cleaners together. Rinse surfaces between product types.
Use disinfectants only with the contact time listed on the product label.
Use Simple Green Outdoor Odor Eliminator outdoors/balcony only and avoid applying it to indoor fabrics.
